picks.title: Colourful sunset likely today 4:38pm
picks.body: 33% odds of colour. Best bets: Indian Shaker Church & Gulick Homestead (The Dalles), Trillium Lake, Salish Ponds Wetland Park (East Pond, Silver Star view). Horizon toward the sun is 50% open.
why: 51% chance of a colourful sunset sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the setting sun 50% open (25–300 km)
picks.lens: 16-50 wide, foreground first; bracket for the bright horizon
